description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Note objects in an Android application. It manages the creation and binding of view holders for each note and handles user interactions with individual note items.

classes.name: NoteListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding Note data to RecyclerView items, including view holder management and data updating.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: Inner class holding references to the views within each note item for efficient recycling.

methods.name: NoteListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with the list of notes and the click handler.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NoteViewHolder by inflating the note item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Note object to a NoteViewHolder, setting text and click listeners.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of notes.

methods.name: updateNotes
methods.description: Public method to update the list of notes and refresh the displayed data.
